messages:
Marta (Recruiter): Hiring update new engineering manager accepted. Hiring manager asked for a succinct "manager onboarding exec summary" they can include in the offer and hand to the new hire on Day 1. Needs to cover: 1) Day-by-day first week checklist, 2) first-10-days leadership priorities, 3) 30/60/90 outcome expectations, and 4) who-to-ping list (ops/finance/security). Can People Ops + DevEx + Finance help build a one-paragraph + checklist bundle?

Priya: Yep. I'll keep it very short & copy-paste friendly. Proposal: a one-paragraph welcome the recruiter can paste, a 7-item day-by-day checklist, and three single-sentence 30/60/90 outcomes.

Jordan (IT): FYI: manager laptop provisioning is ~3 business days. If they need to start earlier we can enable a temporary VM and ship a laptop later. Also we can pre-create SSO account if you give full legal name + personal email.

Sam (DevEx): I'll add quick access commands for repo invites + a short snippet to request infra perms. Also suggest adding a note about code review & deploy privileges being ramped over first 30 days.

Diego (Finance): Heads-up: managers often need a headcount/budget sync in week 2. Recommend a 30-min touch with Finance to review hiring slots & approval flow. I can be that owner.

Priya: Draft below. Keep edits inline.

```
Welcome blurb (paste into offer):
"Welcome! On Day 1 you'll meet with your hiring manager for a 30-min orientation, get access to code, CI, and monitoring, and receive a concise 10-day leadership sprint plan to align on priorities. We'll follow up within 10 days with a draft 30/60/90 and schedule a headcount & budget sync."

Compact Day-by-day (who owns):
Day 0 (pre-start):
- Complete HR paperwork & benefits enrolment (People Ops)
- Confirm laptop shipping or VM access (IT)
- Pre-invite to Slack + calendar + Confluence (People Ops)

Day 1 AM:
- 30-min orientation with hiring manager: role scope, 90-day outcomes (Manager)
- Team all-hands / intro round (Manager)
- Laptop SSO + MFA + email (IT)

Day 1 PM:
- Immediate access checklist: GitHub org, CI, JIRA, Datadog + Redwood Console (DevEx/IT)
- Schedule 1:1 cadence, skip-level intro & weekly leadership syncs (Manager)

Days 2-5 (first week):
- Leadership onboarding: review team OKRs, current deliverables, contractors, and open hiring reqs (Manager + Eng Leads)
- Meet Finance for headcount & budget briefing (Diego)
- Security & compliance briefing (Security)
- Quick shadow: incident runbook & paging flow (Eng-SRE)

By Day 10:
- Share first-draft 30/60/90 and top 3 priorities (Manager + New Hire)
- Confirm mentor/buddy and escalation contacts (Manager)

First-10-days leadership sprint (copy-paste bullets):
- Day 1-3: Listen & map team responsibilities, identify top 3 risk areas.
- Day 4-7: Meet direct reports, set immediate goals, unblock top impediments.
- Day 8-10: Propose 2 concrete actions for next sprint and align resourcing.

30/60/90 (single-sentence outcomes):
- 30d: Understand team scope, own 1 operational deliverable, and run recurring 1:1s.
- 60d: Deliver a committed milestone, propose at least one process or hiring change.
- 90d: Drive roadmap planning for next quarter and present hiring/resource asks to Finance.

Who to ping (fast):
- IT (Jordan): laptop / SSO / VPN
- DevEx (Sam): repo access, CI tokens, deploy perms, local dev setup
- People Ops (Nina): benefits, time-off, 1:1 scheduling help
- Finance (Diego): headcount, budget, hiring approvals
- Eng-SRE: on-call rota, paging/runbook
- Security: trainings & compliance questions

Quick CLI snippets (DevEx):
- Request GitHub invite: `devex request-invite --user email@example.com --team eng-managers`
- Request CI token: `devex request-token --service=ci --scope=repo`
- Expedite laptop: `it-setup-bot create --type manager --priority high --name "Full Name"`
```

Alex M: Love the inclusion of Finance. Add a checkbox to verify access to Datadog dashboards + a note about ramping deploy perms (read-only -> merge -> deploy).

Priya: Added those notes. Also added the "headcount sync" to Day 4 in case hiring manager wants it earlier.

Marta (Recruiter): This is perfect sized. Priya can you post the final Confluence link and exact copy I can paste into offers by EOD?

Priya: Will publish and drop link here by 5pm PST.

Nina (People Ops): Thanks team. Diego, can you join the headcount sync template I'm creating?

Diego (Finance): Yep, send me the template and I'll add the approval flow.

Marta (Recruiter): Thanks all, will attach to the offer docs.
